firing.source:
import { Head } from "next/document";
export const C = () => <Head><title /></Head>;

findings.message: A <title> here is emitted once for every page in the application, because the `Head` from `next/document` renders the shared document shell rather than a page. A page that then sets its own title competes with this one and which wins depends on order. Set the title per page, with `Head` from `next/head`.
